entries.title: Bayesian Dual Control for Cooperative Multi-Robot Source Seeking
entries.organisation: The University of Manchester · PhD Researcher
bullets: Bayesian dual control for robot teams localising an unknown source in a noisy field: each robot’s motion balances reducing uncertainty in the source estimate against converging on it.

Contributions include dual control with consensus mean fusion and a safety projection (CCC 2026), and trace-weighted, event-triggered fusion for communication-efficient source seeking (IAI 2026, Best Paper Award finalist).

entries.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
bullets: Teaches laboratory and tutorial classes across six undergraduate and postgraduate courses in control, robotics and digital electronics, coaching students through controller implementation, robot kinematics and circuit design.

Marks coursework and examinations with written feedback and advises on final-year project demonstrations; contributed to summer 2026 marking and course development and is appointed to EEEN11101 for 2026/27.

entries.title: Guest Lecturer & Experiment Designer (Process Control)
bullets: Designed and built an MSc process-control laboratory: a PLC running PID control, linked to MATLAB/Simulink over OPC for real-time monitoring and analysis.
Delivered guest lectures on the underlying control theory and led the laboratory sessions.
